create.name: Jess Magic
create.bio:
Jess Magic is a singer, storyteller and ceremonial guide whose work joins music with embodiment and ritual. For around fifteen years she has toured festivals, retreats and leadership gatherings, singing gospel-flavoured songs, improvising with audiences and acting as master of ceremonies at events such as Bali Spirit Festival. She created the Soul Salon, an evening in which a hand-picked group of musicians and speakers weave stories, original songs and improvisation together with the audience, and took it online in 2020 as a series of Virtual Soul Salons. Her Gospel Brunch gatherings invite people of any faith or none to sing together without dogma.

Under the name MWALI she has set up a non-denominational spiritual foundation with a temple space in Austin, Texas, built around monthly music services, ritual and community. She also works one to one as a coach for leaders and entrepreneurs, using voice, presence and body awareness to help them live from the heart, and has run voice and embodiment programmes for women. In podcast conversations she talks about treating everyday life as a ceremony and about freeing the voice. At Kripalu she co-leads, with Eset Rose, a weekend on creativity, vitality and sacred aliveness.

courses.title: Radiance: The Art of Becoming Fully Alive
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu, co-led with Eset Rose, on reconnecting with creativity, vitality and a sense of the sacred in the body. The programme uses movement, sound, breath, ritual, creative exercises and group inquiry, drawing on cyclic living and the Beauty Way.

courses.title: Freedom Coaching
courses.description: A three-month one-to-one coaching programme for leaders and high achievers, with weekly sessions, ongoing accountability and an optional private ceremony. It starts with a discovery call and centres on presence, connection and living from the heart.

flags: Mainly a musician, emcee and coach with spiritual framing; included because she leads ceremonies, the MWALI spiritual foundation and embodiment programmes, but a human may want to confirm fit.
Her Kripalu programme is co-led with Eset Rose (rank 14, skipped as too thin); Eset is named in the bio and offering only.
All four videos are podcast interviews on other channels where she is the sole guest; her own YouTube channels hold only short music and Soul Salon trailers.
Availability set to worldwide: MWALI's Temple of Love is in Austin, Texas, but its listed Soul Salon dates carry no year and look out of date, so a current local base is not confirmed.
Only one photo confirmed (Kripalu headshot); site photos include a nude shoot and were not used.
Email connect@jessmagic.com is her booking and press address.
left_out: Free Your Voice (8-week virtual programme): last schedule shown is 2021, and its page frames it around moving old traumas; left out.
Permission retreat in Costa Rica (11 to 18 Mar 2023): passed.
MWALI membership: described as what membership 'will include', with Soul Salon dates that carry no year; not confirmed as current.
Soul Salons, Virtual Soul Salons, Gospel Brunch and Mistress of Ceremony: booked performances and events with no current dates or prices.
Making Art of Your Wounds (John Wineland channel): she shares it with a second guest, Jamie Thompson.
Music and freestyle videos on her own channels: music only or under two minutes.
